entities.summary: Errenzhuan is a genre of musical theater and folk dance from Northeast China, usually involving two performers. The dance uses folding fans or square-shaped red handkerchiefs, which are twirled as the songs are performed. It is popular due to its comedic dialogue and sketches, which have obfuscated the old dances and songs.
